backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the mod repository backend with CRUD operations: upload, retrieve, list, delete (admin-only), and download count increment, plus indexed lookups by author and category with access control via MixinAuthorization.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a no-op state migration module that maps the old actor state shape to the new actor state shape, preserving all mod data and indexes unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (login/logout UI, protected upload page, My Mods page) to their source files, component dependencies, and test requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-line descriptions of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose of each component, page, hook, and style file.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the NFS Mods Hub SPA, mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point as an ES module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with four routes (home, upload, mod detail, my-mods) wrapped in a shared Layout and a dark Toaster notification provider.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Sticky navigation bar component with logo, Browse Mods and conditional My Mods links, Internet Identity login/logout controls showing the abbreviated principal, and an authenticated-only Upload Mod button.
frontend/src/components/ModCard.tsx: Clickable mod card component rendering title, category badge with color coding, game tag, author, upload date, file size, and download count with a neon hover effect.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend mod operations: listing, fetching by ID or author, uploading, deleting, and incrementing download counts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, and defines a dark racing-themed design system with OKLCH CSS custom properties for colors, neon accents, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ModDetailPage.tsx: Page component that displays full details for a single mod fetched by ID, including metadata, file info, and a download button that increments the download count.
frontend/src/pages/ModListingPage.tsx: Page component that shows a searchable, filterable grid of all mods with a hero banner, category/game selectors, and navigation to upload or mod detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/ModUploadPage.tsx: A form page for uploading NFS mods, collecting title, description, game, category, and file via drag-and-drop or file picker. Requires Internet Identity authentication and calls the backend uploadMod mutation on submit.
frontend/src/pages/MyModsPage.tsx: A page displaying the authenticated user's uploaded mods in a list with metadata (game, date, downloads, file size) and delete functionality via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a dark racing-themed design system with neon accent colors, custom fonts (Barlow Condensed, Inter), neon box shadows, and extended color tokens using oklch variables.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the current version, summary, and list of implemented features for an NFS mod-sharing website with Internet Identity authentication.
